The main takeaway from our work is that

the T-matrix approach provides a consistent description of heavy quarks and electrons at RHIC, and that the heavy-quark transport coefficients extracted from the T-matrix calculations are in agreement with recent lattice-QCD calculations.

the T-matrix treatment of elastic scattering of heavy quarks with light quarks in the QGP leads to a substantial increase of the heavy-quark diffusion coefficient, which results in a significant enhancement of v2(pT) and a reduction of the non-photonic single-electron yield at low pt.
